text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I didn't win? Are you kidding me?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I didn't win? Are you kidding me?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So what? It doesn't mean squat if I don't
place!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the whole reason I lost because I
don't have
any strengths?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No thanks. That sounds like torture. I'll
take the
recordings, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I suppose watching my past races for
reference
isn't such a bad idea.)

A few days later, I give Narita Taishin
the replays
along with some notes on her
running.

She seems annoyed by the notes, but
thankfully,
she takes everything, and we
get started on our
training session.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win and win and win...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And I'll rise high above the others so
that no
one'll ever talk bad about me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You're really getting too fired up about this.

The moment we get back, I look over
her training
schedule and talk to her
about the next race,
but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the next one, so calm down
already!

Despite being fed up with me, Narita
Taishin is
dead set on claiming victory.
